_design: A Series A sheet whose ten business days have run out does not close on its own. The sheet stays in active_sheets, due (TermSheet.is_decision_due), and this card asks for the answer: sit down now, or decline and the fund is closed for good. Two options and no third - no 'later' row, and an interrupt, so it cannot be dismissed or deferred. Decline is the PLAYER'S answer, so decline_offer closes the fund without counting a rejection. HOURLY and critical so that two sheets closing on the same day arrive one after the other on that day: the queue holds one instance of a card id, the first answer frees it, and the next hourly sweep binds the other fund through the decision_sheet selector. cooldown_days 1 per entity: if a sitting somehow ends with the sheet still due, the card comes back the next day rather than never. No speaker - this is the plain fact of the offer, not Frank's voice (his lines for this surface are an open decision in docs/ACIK_KARARLAR.md).

tr.title: VC_EV_DECISION_TITLE
tr.body:
{investor} teklifinin süresi doldu. Fon şimdi bir cevap bekliyor.

Tahmini şartlar: değerleme {seam:investor.est_valuation} · pay {seam:investor.est_dilution}.

Masaya oturursan şartlar netleşir. Reddedersen bu fon kalıcı olarak kapanır.

en.title: VC_EV_DECISION_TITLE
en.body:
The offer from {investor} has run its time. The fund wants an answer now.

Estimated terms: valuation {seam:investor.est_valuation} · equity {seam:investor.est_dilution}.

Sit down and the terms become exact. Decline and this fund is closed for good.
